Personal

Rule: Once during this encounter, you can use the Form of the Avalanche Unleashed Attack power while you are in this form.

Grants: Form of the Avalanche Unleashed Attack

Melee weapon

Requirement: The power Form of the Avalanche Unleashed must be active in order to use this power.

Target: One creature

Attack: Strength vs. AC

Hit: 1[W] + Strength damage, and you knock the target prone. The target is stunned (save ends).

Miss: Half damage, and the target is dazed (save ends).

presentation.description:

Rule: Once during this encounter, you can use the Form of the Crushing Mountain Attack power while you are in this form.

Grants: Form of the Crushing Mountain Attack

ENCOUNTER / STANDARD

Close burst 3

Requirement: The power Form of the Crushing Mountain must be active in order to use this power.

Target: Each enemy you can see in the burst

Attack: Strength vs. AC

Hit: 1[W] + Strength damage, and you pull the target 2 squares.

Miss: Half damage, and you pull the target 1 square.

presentation.description:
You assume the aspect of a tiger, boosting your speed and agility, especially when your allies are under attack.

DAILY / MINOR

Personal

Effect: You assume the guardian form of the hunting tiger until the end of the encounter. While you are in this form, you gain a +2 bonus to speed and Reflex. In addition, when any enemy marked by you makes an attack roll against any of your allies, you can shift 2 squares toward that enemy as a free action.

Rule: Once during this encounter, you can use the Form of the Hunting Tiger Attack power while you are in this form.

Grants: Form of the Hunting Tiger Attack

ENCOUNTER / STANDARD

Melee weapon

Requirement: The power Form of the Hunting Tiger must be active in order to use this power.

Target: One creature

Attack: Strength vs. AC

Hit: 1[W] + Strength damage. If both of your attack rolls would hit, the attack deals 10 extra damage.

Miss: Half damage.

Attack: Make the attack roll twice and use either result.
